seo.title: Elbadaouy Bilal — Software Engineer
seo.description: Elbadaouy Bilal is a software engineer building accessible, human-centered products for the web. Explore projects in React, Node.js and Python.

hero.headline: I build things for the web.
hero.description: Software engineer specializing in building — and occasionally designing — exceptional digital experiences. Currently focused on accessible, human-centered products.

about.title: About
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Bilal, and I enjoy creating things that live on the internet. My interest in web development started with tinkering on small personal projects — hacking together HTML & CSS taught me a lot about how the web actually works.

Since then I've had the chance to work across advertising, start-up, and enterprise contexts. My main focus these days is building accessible, inclusive products and reliable digital experiences for a variety of clients.
When I'm not at the computer, I'm usually reading, exploring new ideas, or going down a rabbit hole about something I just discovered.

featured.title: E-Commerce Analytics Dashboard
featured.description: A comprehensive dashboard for e-commerce vendors to track sales, monitor inventory levels, and analyze customer demographics. Built with real-time data visualization components.

featured.title: Collaborative Task Manager
featured.description: A Kanban-style project management tool allowing teams to create, assign, and track tasks in real-time. Features include drag-and-drop functionality, comments, and file attachments.

other.title: Weather App CLI
other.description: A command-line interface tool built in Python to fetch and display real-time weather data for any given city using a public API.

other.title: Personal Blog Template
other.description: A minimalist, fast-loading blog template built with static site generation for personal writers.

other.title: Algorithm Visualizer
other.description: An educational web app that visually animates common sorting algorithms (Bubble, Merge, Quick) to help students learn.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.description: Although I'm not currently looking for new opportunities, my inbox is always open. Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, I'll try my best to get back to you.
